posts.text: America is pretty cruel to its soccer prodigies. Bc we aren’t really invested in men’s soccer and the only dudes the normies ever hear about are the saviors, they don’t really get to either just be mid or even flame out like 90% of the prodigies in other countries.
posts.summary: U.S. soccer culture sets unrealistic expectations on young players
